text_content: This is a project pitching event for students to present their project ideas and recruit prospective teammates and academic advisors to form student interest groups on a wide range of topics like robotics, artificial intelligence, electric automobiles and healthcare technologies. The learning process helps to improve students’ ability to effectively advocate an idea or project to a large group of audience. It also allows flexibility for students to form their own team and grow their community of interest and passion.

[Poster Transcription: Event name
- Pitch New Tech Ideas (Pioneering Solutions for Tomorrow’s Challenges)

Organizer
- Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, The University of Hong Kong (HKU)

Themes / Challenge areas
- Human–AI Collaboration
- Water Sustainability
- Design for an Aging Population

Key dates
- Proposal submission deadline: by 11:59 pm, March 1, 2026
- Pitching event: shortlisted teams invited in March 2026

Funding / cost
- Chance to win up to HK$100,000 in funding support to further develop ideas in the Innovation Wing
- No participation cost stated

Location / contact
- Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, HKU
- Website: https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk
- More details via QR code on the poster

Sponsors / supporters
- Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund
- Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund

Additional notes
- All proposals will receive suggestions for improvement; shortlisted proposals will be invited to the pitching event.] Our past events:
